availability_audit: Chronology anchor: Route 113 is reached after Mauville/Wattson (cap 30) via Route 111 -> Route 112 -> Fiery Path, per Game Book C20/C21. Every member below is in work/reference-pools/pool-36.json with gate <= 36 and a source_detail map the player has already passed on the way to Route 113: Seaspray Cave B1F (Sneasel), Rusturf Tunnel (Drilbur), Petalburg City Old Rod (Magikarp), Route 102 (Togepi), Mauville Game Corner (Litten), Granite Cave 1F (Abra). No Route 118+, Mt. Pyre, desert-interior or post-Flannery sources are used. Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly (C13); Gyaradosite stone window 20. Adds New Mauville_Entrance (Magnezone, pool gate 30) and Petalburg Woods (Heracross, pool gate 14, Heracronite stone window 14). New Mauville is entered from Mauville after Wattson; Route 113 is reached from Mauville via Route 111/112/Fiery Path, so both are behind the player.
plan: Coby is four Flying types behind a Mirror Armor Corviknight and a Competitive Kilowattrel. The dossier is explicit that indiscriminate Intimidate is a trap, so Incineroar and Gyarados are deliberately benched despite being my two best Fire/Water attackers - no member of this party carries Intimidate or any stat-lowering secondary. The crack asks for Electric and Rock pressure and special damage into the physical wall: Excadrill's Rock Slide is 2x into Toucannon, Honchkrow and Kilowattrel and Excadrill is flatly immune to Kilowattrel's Thunderbolt; Magnezone's Thunderbolt is 2x into Corviknight itself (Electric is neutral on Steel and 2x on Flying) and answers the Roost/Body Press wall specially; Weavile's Ice Shard outspeeds Honchkrow's Sucker Punch problem by simply being priority too, and Knock Off strips the Scope Lens that the Super Luck crit plan depends on.
